translation.name: Yuusa chichame yaunchukia tura yamaram chichamjai aarmau

book.name: 2 Timoteo
book.title: TIMOTEO ATAKSHA AWENTSARIK PAPI AARA AKUPTUKMAU

content: Nugka mesertin jeatsaig shuar urukuk artinait tusa jintinkartuamu
Timoteowa, jusha nekamainaitme: Nugka mesertin jeatsaig nukap waitamu atinaiti.

Shuar ainaka ima ninunak enentaimtiartinaiti, suri, kuitnak enentaimtin, ememau, ima nigki anenmamin, Yuusnasha pachisar pegkerchau chicharin, ni aparincha umirchau, Yuusnasha maaketi tichau artinaiti.
Tura chikich ainancha wait anenchau, chichaman tsanumin, nuwanak wekaitin, chikich shuarnasha waitkau, shuar pegker aina kajertai artinaiti.
Tura ni patainak waitkasarti tusa chikich shuarnum surin, pegkerchau takatnasha araantus enentaimchau, nigki emematmamin, Yuusan enentaimtutsuk nita wakeramunak yujariartinaiti.
Jesucriston umirnujai metek iwainmamiartinaiti, turasha nita takamurigka Criston umirnusha urukua amainaita nujai metekka achartinaiti. Shuar tumau ainajaigka iruuntraipa.
Nu shuar ainaka jeanam wayawar, nuwa shir enentaimkachu asar, tunaun takau ainan tsanuinawai.
Nu nuwa ainaka chicham nekasa nuna unuimartajai tuinawai, turasha chicham nekasa nunaka unuimainatsui.
Nu shuar ainaka chicham nekasa nunaka nakitainawai. Tura tunau takatan enentaimtuinak Yuusan nekaspapita tuinatsui. Yaunchuk iwishin Janes, Jambrésjai Moisésa shuari ajakarua numamtuketi.
Turasha ashi shuar aina nita tsanukratmaun nekaina asarmatai, yaunchuk jimar iwishin Moisésjai shuarmania jakua numamtuk asar, nita tsanukratku takamurinka emtikachartin ainawai.

Turasha ameka wii jintinkartuamua nuke shir nekame. Ameka wii Yuusan umiru asan, pegkeran takaj nuke takame. Shuar ainan ashi anea asan, jintintiamsha wári unuimainachkaisha inaiyatsuj nuke ameka nekame. Tura shuar aina pegkerchau amajtuinakaisha Yuusa chichamen jintinkartutnaka inaiyatsuj nuka ameka nekame.
Tura Antioquíanmaya, Iconionmaya, Listranmayasha, iman yaaktanmaya wina pataturkar waitkarainakaisha, katsuntrauwaitaj nuka ameka shir nekame. Turasha winaka Yuus ayamrutkauwaiti.
Ashi shuar Jesucristojai pujut pegkernum pujustaj tuinaka waitkam artinaiti.
Turasha shuar tunau tura chikichan tsanu ainaka chikich tsanuam nu senchi tunau jainawai.
Timoteowa, ameka kakaram pujusam, ameka iturchat enentaimtsuk chicham nekasa nu unuimarmauka metek umikta. Ameka yainiyampa unuimarmiam nuka nekame.
Ameka uchiich asamek, Yuusa chichame pegkera nu, amina nekamtikramawa nuka, tura Jesucristo nekaspapita tamaunam uwemna nusha antukuitme.

Ju chichama junaka Yuus enentaimtikmau asa, shuar aina aararuiti. Yuus nina chichamen shuar ainatin jintinkartuattsa, tura tunau takamuncha nekamtikartuattsa, tura tunau takatsuk pujutnasha nekamtikramattsa aamtikrauwaiti.
Tuma asamtai Yuus nemarin ainatika ashi ni timauwa turusrik umirmainaitji, turakur ashi pegker aina takamainaitji.
